data.name: Awan
data.gender_notes: Awan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘awna’, meaning ‘to give’ or ‘to offer’. In Islamic tradition, the name Awan is given to a child as a sign of gratitude for God’s blessings. It is also associated with the idea of giving and generosity. The name Awan carries the meaning “Gift” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Awan usually hope their child will grow to embody gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to be a giver and receiver of God's blessings.
data.etymology: Awan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Awan total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: عوان
in_arabic.meaning: عوان اسم معنی ہے جو کسی شخص کی مدد یا تعاون کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے
in_arabic.long_meaning: عوان (ع و ن) کا معنی ہے مدد یا حمایت کرنا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ اللہ کی مدد اور تعاون کی یاد دلاتا ہے۔ قرآن میں بھی 'عوان' کی اصطلاح پائی جاتی ہے جو فلاح و رفاہ کے لئے کام کرنے کی ترغیب دیتی ہے۔

in_urdu.name: عوان
in_urdu.meaning: عوان کا مطلب ہے مدد کرنا یا کسی کی حمایت کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: عوان (ع و ن) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے مدد یا تعاون کرنا۔ اسلامی تقالید میں یہ نام بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ اللہ کی طرف سے دی جانے والی مدد کی یاد دلاتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے یہ نام روحانی اور ثقافتی اہمیت کا حامل ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अवाँ
in_hindi.meaning: अवाँ का अर्थ है मदद करना या किसी की सहायता करना
in_hindi.long_meaning: अवाँ (अ व ां) नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है जिसका अर्थ है मदद करना या समर्थन करना। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम आध्यात्मिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्व रखता है। यह नाम अल्लाह की मदद और सहयोग की याद दिलाता है।

in_pashto.name: عوان
in_pashto.meaning: عوان دے مانى دى چى کومک يا مرسته کول
in_pashto.long_meaning: عوان (ع و ن) په عربي ژبه کې دى چى کومک يا مرسته کول. په افغان او پښتون دود کې دا نوم ډېر اهم دى ځکه چى د الهي مرستې او ملاتړ يادونه ورکوي.

in_english.name: Awan
in_english.meaning: Awan means helper or supporter in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: The name Awan (ع و ن) originates from Arabic roots 'ayn-waw-nun' which signify helping or supporting. In Islamic tradition, Awan holds spiritual significance as it alludes to divine assistance and support. Historically, the term appears in the Quran, emphasizing the importance of aiding and supporting others. The name symbolizes benevolence, kindness, and strength, reflecting positive personality traits. Across Muslim cultures, Awan remains a meaningful and culturally significant name.

The meaning of ‘to give’ or 'to offer' reflects the value placed on generosity and hospitality in Islamic culture. This name may be especially meaningful for families who have welcomed a newborn child into their home and feel grateful for the blessing of a healthy, growing family.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Awan also holds significant spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. Additionally, the name Awan encourages the practice of giving and generosity, as people remember to be kind and offer assistance to others in need.
